results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT
  la.category,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.deals d ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: The average time to sell varies by category, with bikes_transport at 11.20 days, clothing at 11.32 days, dorm_essentials at 11.39 days, electronics at 11.40 days, furniture at 11.61 days, kitchen at 11.49 days, other at 12.08 days, sports_outdoors at 11.56 days, and textbooks at 11.56 days. Overall, the nine categories show averages ranging from 11.20 to 12.08 days.

results.question: average rating buyers give sellers, by item category

SELECT c.category,
       c.label,
       ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating
FROM nlq.reviews r
JOIN nlq.deals d ON r.deal_id = d.deal_id
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
JOIN nlq.categories c ON l.category = c.category

GROUP BY c.category, c.label

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
WITH returned AS (
  SELECT d.*, c.period
  FROM nlq.deals d
  JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
  WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
    AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
    AND c.period IN ('finals', 'classes')
)
SELECT
  period,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS late_return_rate_percent
FROM returned
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period;
results.answer: Across all time, rentals due during regular classes had 2,742 rentals with a 19.66% late‑return rate, while rentals due during finals had 134 rentals with an 18.66% late‑return rate.
